function.name: search_yc_directory
function.description: Searches the Y Combinator startup directory by batch, industry, keywords, or hiring status to find relevant prospective startups.

batch.description: The YC batch name to filter by, e.g., 'Fall 2026', 'Summer 2026', 'Winter 2026'.

is_hiring.description: Filter strictly for companies currently hiring.

limit.description: Maximum number of startups to return (1-50). Default is 20.

function.name: fetch_batch_startups
function.description: Fetches the full startup roster for a specific YC batch from the directory index.
